lessons.title: Auction Theory & eCPM Optimization
overview: Understand Facebook's auction formula: Total Value = Bid × Estimated Action Rate + User Value.
Structure broad-targeting campaigns that let the algorithm self-optimize efficiently.

takeaways.title: Creative as Targeting
takeaways.desc: Use specific hook formats to filter intent rather than micro-interest layering.

takeaways.title: Bid Cap Tactics
takeaways.desc: Deploy manual bid caps during peak seasonal events to protect ROAS.

lessons.title: Creative Fatigue Cycling & Dynamic Testing
overview: Implement 3:2:2 Dynamic Creative Testing frameworks to identify winning hooks, copy, and visual formats.
Rotate ad variants systematically before frequency saturation degrades conversion efficiency.

takeaways.title: Hook-Hold Ratios
takeaways.desc: Diagnose video creative using 3-second hook drop-off vs 50% watch time.

takeaways.title: Scaling Horizontal
takeaways.desc: Scale winning post IDs into consolidated CBO campaigns without reset.
